newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Entergy glowing on London.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Entergy glowing on London.

text.p: U.S. power group Entergy said on Wednesday its strong cash flow enabled it to be an aggressive buyer of other firms but that its agreed bid for London Electricity represented a fair deal for all parties.

Entergy's chairman and CEO Ed Lupberger said he preferred not to comment on the process leading to Wednesday's 1.267 billion stg offer for London Electricity but conceded its chairman Sir Bob Reid had driven a hard bargain.
"Sir Bob and his team did an excellent job of extracting a generous price out of us," he told Reuters in an interview. The offer values each London Electricity share at 705 pence.
